name: Dune Analytics
tagline: SQL-powered blockchain analytics API for querying on-chain data
description: Dune Analytics provides a REST API for executing SQL queries against blockchain data, retrieving results, managing queries, and accessing pre-built dashboards and tables. Developers use API keys to run queries programmatically, poll for results, and integrate on-chain analytics into apps and data pipelines.

auth.details: API key via X-Dune-Api-Key header (self-serve from account settings)

use_cases: run a saved Dune SQL query and fetch results
poll query execution status by execution id
list or search public blockchain analytics queries
export on-chain metrics into a data pipeline
check credits or API usage for a Dune account
